presets.title: Cold Stare
presets.description: Minimal sigma stare edit: extreme close-ups on the eyes, freeze frames and zoom ladders on the beat, monochrome with one red accent and massive condensed type.

recipe.look: bw-contrast with a red accent on titles only, heavy grain, deep vignette
recipe.energy: Few cuts (≤1 per second) but a zoom ladder (stepped punch-ins) on every beat, freeze frames on accents, one hard flash at the climax.

structure.guidance: Static extreme close-up; nothing moves but a slow blink.
Stepped zoom punches toward the eyes on each beat; words stack beside the face.
Flash, freeze on the eyes, title word in red.

recipe.titles: Huge Anton words filling the frame width, slam animation, one word per beat.
recipe.music: Slow, heavy beat with long reverb; space between hits matters.
recipe.generation: One or two keyframes are enough: an extreme close-up and a medium shot; animate with very subtle I2V motion (blink, breath).

presets.prompt: @image1 stares through the lens without emotion; keep every facial detail identical to the photo.
presets.author: open-katana

presets.title: Neon Rain
presets.description: Moody night aura edit: slow-motion hero moments in a rain-wet city, teal-and-black grade, glow, white flashes on the drops and slammed blackletter titles.

recipe.look: teal-night grade, crushed blacks, light film grain, soft glow on highlights, subtle vignette
recipe.energy: Slow first act (1–2 cuts per second), then cuts on every beat after the drop with zoom punches and short shake bursts on hits; 3–5 white flashes per 10 s, always on hits.

structure.guidance: Slow push-in on the hero in shadow; eyes lift to the lens. No text yet.
Details: hands, jacket, silhouette against city lights, a walk toward camera in slow motion.
White flash on the drop, slam the title word in blackletter with glow.
Beat-cut montage of stares, turns and wind in hair; punch-ins on every second beat; one freeze frame.
Final slow stare into the lens, flash out to black on the last hit.

recipe.titles: One or two words max per card, uppercase, centred; blackletter for the title word, Anton for captions.
recipe.music: Dark phonk or slowed trap with a clear drop; use the reference's track when one is supplied.
recipe.generation: Keyframes: compose the hero into each night location plate (rain-wet street, underpass, rooftop). Clips: 2–3 s Wan I2V slow-motion moments; motion transfer with pose control only for performances the reference needs.

presets.prompt: Make @image1 the hero of a dark aura edit. Keep their face, hair and clothing exactly; nights are wet, neon reflections are teal, and every move is slow and deliberate.
presets.author: open-katana

presets.title: Golden Hour
presets.description: Soft golden-hour hero edit: dreamy warm grade, soft white flashes, gentle handheld drift, film grain and elegant serif captions.

recipe.look: warm-film to dreamy grade, lifted blacks, halation glow, medium grain
recipe.energy: Calm: ~1 cut per second, soft 0.15 s white flashes on phrase changes, handheld drift on every shot, no hard shake.

structure.guidance: Back-lit walk at golden hour, hair catching the sun.
Laughs, glances over the shoulder, spinning slowly, close-ups of outfit details.
Slow turn to camera with a smile; caption fades in.

recipe.titles: Lower-case italic serif captions, fade or rise animation, generous letter spacing.
recipe.music: Indie or lo-fi with a gentle beat; cut on phrase starts rather than every beat.
recipe.generation: Locations: sunlit field, rooftop, seaside promenade. Slow 3 s I2V clips with gentle camera moves.

presets.prompt: @image1 has the whole golden hour to themselves; keep their face and outfit exactly.
presets.author: open-katana

presets.title: Phonk Velocity
presets.description: High-energy velocity edit: speed ramps that snap into slow motion on the beat, strobing black-and-white inserts, heavy shake on the bass and chromatic splits.

recipe.look: high contrast, desaturated with alternating black-and-white and inverted 2–4 frame inserts, RGB split on hits
recipe.energy: 2–4 cuts per second; every clip ramps from fast (2×) to slow (0.3×) landing on a beat; shake bursts on every kick; strobe during the build.

structure.guidance: Hard cut in on a fast move, ramp into slow motion on beat 2.
Alternating colour and black-and-white inserts, strobe, accelerating cut rate.
Freeze frame + red accent word slam.
Velocity ramps on every bar; last shot holds on the hero, hard cut to black.

recipe.titles: Single red accent word in Archivo Black at the drop; small monospaced captions in corners.
recipe.music: Drift phonk with a heavy cowbell line; cut on kicks and cowbell hits.
recipe.generation: Generate 3–4 s clips with strong single actions (turn, walk, jacket flick) so ramps have motion to slow down; I2V at 16 fps then blend-interpolate in the edit.

presets.prompt: @image1 is the hero. Every shot is a decisive motion that can be ramped: turning, stepping forward, pulling a jacket on.
presets.author: open-katana
